## How it was checked

<!-- The tests you added. If the clones found change: on which code, and how. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The tests were written before the code, and `just check` passes
- [ ] `just hygiene` passes (typos, licences)
- [ ] If the clones found change: the change is listed under "Faithful, and where it differs" in the README, with its test
- [ ] A file taken from Clone Digger 1.1.0 that is modified says so, with the date, under its original copyright
- [ ] The commit messages start with `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `build:`, `ci:`, `perf:` or `chore:`
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org)
